CustomField.description: When non-null, the Home "Hours without approval" card is on AND this timestamp is the cutover: only WorkLogs created at or after it, whose parent request is not Accepted / In Progress / Completed, are flagged. Older hours are never flagged. Null = card hidden. Changing the stamp moves the cutover, so clearing and re-stamping it re-baselines what counts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set to a date/time to flag hours logged from that moment on without an approved request. Leave blank to turn the card off.
CustomField.label: Enable Unapproved Hours Flag
